firstPlayerRule: The first dealer is chosen by a draw for high card. The player on the dealer’s left starts the bidding and makes the opening lead.
clarifications: The deal then passes clockwise each hand.

sources.title: Spades — How to Play
sources.publisher: Bicycle Cards (The United States Playing Card Company)

internalEvidence: Read the Bicycle Cards (United States Playing Card Company) Spades page in a browser. "The Deal": "The first dealer is chosen by a draw for high card, and thereafter the turn to deal proceeds clockwise." "The Bidding": "The player to the dealer’s left starts the bidding." "The Play": "The player on the dealer’s left makes the opening lead."
uncertainty: The page does not say how to break a tie in the draw for first dealer.
